description: One temp-module compile/reject helper (stable md5 name, returns :ok or the CompileError message) with codes/1 and whats/1; one kernel_c/2 (one way to read generated C: __defk_c_source__); G.pack instead of 17 i64s / 9 f64s copies; one wait_until; one env save/restore; Defk.Examples.parse_results for DEFK_RESULT. Add a min_yields: option to Defk.Test.assert_agrees (public test API - needs a maintainer decision) so ~22 files drop hand-rolled __defk_force_yields__ try/after blocks and five yield counters. Done when the copies are gone and the suite passes.

comments.text: min_yields: done as Defk.TestKit.assert_agrees_yielding/4 in test/support, not as a Defk.Test.assert_agrees option: no public API change needed. Possible follow-ups from the converters: a forced_yields/2 (yields + forced, nested 7x in early_exit), i16s/i32s/f32s with :inf/:nan, a multi-line defk_results/1 for bench_cache.
